candidate_delta.commit_rule: Use a stable host handle/capability to the bound object, or re-resolve at commit and require exact identity equality before effect release.
candidate_delta.reason: String/path equivalence and resolve-once checks do not preserve resource identity across alias/rebinding races.

claim_boundary: Synthetic namespace model only; not a Linux/openat2 reproduction.
Attack frequencies are coverage choices, not production rates.
Stable-handle and re-resolve/verify arms are modeled ideally and do not prove a future implementation race-free.
The result motivates OS/API-specific resource identity witnesses and atomic/handle-based commit tests.
